description: Start the historical Shopify order backfill: a durable background import of the order history that predates the store's connect date. Live tenants only — sandbox/trial tenants keep the connect-date cutoff and are refused. At most one backfill runs per store; re-triggering while one is active is refused. Poll progress via get_integration_status (provider 'shopify'). Requires an operator (unpinned) org token with write access.
name: trigger_shopify_order_backfill
title: Start Shopify Order Backfill
